description: This file defines the core Database class for the Notesnook project, managing database initialization, synchronization, event handling, and collection management.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Main class managing database setup, synchronization, event handling, and collection initialization for Notesnook.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the database with provided options.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the database, clears data, and reinitializes schema and collections.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database, sets up event subscriptions, creates the database schema, and initializes collections.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback for additional setup after database creation, such as creating triggers.

methods.name: initCollections
methods.description: Initializes all data collections and legacy collections.

methods.name: connectSSE
methods.description: Establishes an SSE connection for real-time updates.

methods.name: hasUnsyncedChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are unsynced changes.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Configures host URLs for various services.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Fetches the current version of the API.

methods.name: announcements
methods.description: Fetches active announcements, optionally filtered by user.
